name: garba-partner
description: Garba Partner — find Garba partners and events safely.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names packages,api,web,admin --prefix-colors gray,blue,magenta,yellow "npm:dev:packages" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:admin"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
